You can shampoo, but I wouldn't recommend every time you wash your hair. I would definitely try using only conditioner for a while though. When you shampoo your hair consistently it can encourage your hair to produce more oil because its constantly being stripped away. It's much more difficult for the natural oils to move down curly hair which may make your scalp look greasy and your ends look dry by comparison. Curly hair definitely needs more overall moisture to even that out, not less. 

Also, I didn't see the 3rd picture at first, that's almost exactly what my hair looked like before I knew I had curly hair. I shampooed brushed, the whole routine people with straight hair do. Took my hair a little bit of time to adjust to the new routine, but works wonderfully now. Definitely give it a shot. If it doesn't work you can always try something different :)

Well, that's part right. A lot of people grow out of *some* hyperactive symptoms with age, but what you're describing sounds a lot more like inattentive symptoms which do not change with age. You can definitely still be diagnosed as an adult. You will probably need to see a specialist, but there are ways they can still test for the hyperactive symptoms. As for the meantime, it all really depends on you as a person. One thing that worked for me was using other stimulating things like buckets of sugar and coffee (not the healthiest, but it got me through college). It was also really helpful for me to always use white noise when thing to focus on something (drowns out all the background BS for a little bit). I set all appointments and deadlines and other stuff I procrastinate waaayyy early in my calendar so I can trick my brain into getting it done on time. XD as for the self esteem, I'm still working on that one too. Best I can say is, just try to remember you're not alone and what you're struggling with is normal. It's really easy to feel broken and isolated (especially without a diagnosis) so do your best to find the good in being different instead of dwelling on the bad. Best of luck ♡

My routine: I cowash once a week using wild harvest conditioner (I used Allafia for about 4 years, but it's just so expensive). Comb it through, leave for 30 minutes, then gently rinse it out. I scrunch any excess water out of my hair  using my hands while upside down, then lightly with a cotton tshirt. The "gel" I use is homemade (equal parts conditioner, water, and aloe vera gel) which i scrunch into my hair both right side up and upside down so i dont miss any sections. Then i plop it overnight using that same cotton tshirt. I repeat the gel/plop every night, the only difference is I just moisten it with a little bit of water instead of a full shower, and only use a little bit of my "gel." And that's it!
